settings.heading: Can I personalize the designs by selecting size and color?
settings.row_content: Yes. You can choose size and color on every product page. Text and image customization aren't available at this time.

settings.heading: How long does it take to process and ship orders?
settings.row_content: Typical processing time is 1–4 business days from the date of purchase. See our Shipping & Handling page for delivery details.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: We accept PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, and American Express. All transactions are processed securely.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.row_content: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number and link.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.row_content: See our Refund Policy page for full return details.
